title: MembershipChanged, as Transports reads it
description: Published by Auth & Users (farol.auth-users, routing key membership.changed), consumed from transports.auth-users-events into the membership copy (spec #193 D3). Copied from Events (backend/events/contracts/events/consumed), which reads it the same way; the producer's own contract (#191) wins where they differ. Full state with a version: Transports upserts its copy, ignores a version not newer than the one it has and keeps Removed rows; a missing status is read as Active.

status.description: Optional: read as Active when missing
